subject: Science (Class 10)

scope_items.text: Resistance, Resistivity, factors on which the resistance of a conductor depends
Series and parallel combination of resistors and their daily-life applications
Heating effect of electric current and its daily-life applications
Electric power, interrelation between P, V, I and R

avoid: Current is not 'used up' in a series circuit; resistance of a wire depends on length, area, material and temperature, not on the current; in parallel the equivalent resistance is LESS than the smallest resistance; 1 kWh = 3.6 x 10^6 J.
practicals: V-I graph for a resistor (Ohm's law)
Equivalent resistance of two resistors in series and in parallel
outcomes_note: Chapter-level outcomes are not printed in the source; the competency split for the paper is Knowledge/Understanding 50%, Application 30%, Analyse/Evaluate/Create 20%.
